parsed.draft_response:
Hi team — thanks for flagging this, and I’m sorry this is impacting production reporting for ~40 enterprise customers.

Based on what you shared, the Salesforce sync failures began after your v2.8 upgrade and the logs show repeated authentication token refresh errors. This does require urgent engineering attention, so I’m escalating it for human review.

To help engineering move quickly (and minimize any delay before your renewal call tomorrow), could you reply with the following minimum details?
1) The exact build/version of v2.8 and which environment/region/tenant is affected (production vs staging).
2) Whether all Salesforce sync jobs are failing or only specific customers/objects.
3) The exact auth/token refresh error text (including timestamps and any error codes/stack trace snippets).
4) Whether any refresh/auth attempts ever succeed, and the approximate failure cadence (e.g., every X minutes).
5) Whether any Salesforce connection/OAuth configuration or credentials were changed during/around the upgrade.
6) If you have a current workaround that restores any reporting, please share what’s working and for whom.

Promised next steps: engineering will review the upgrade + auth/token refresh logs for the affected environment and advise on the fastest path to restore sync/reporting while investigating.

If you can provide the log excerpts with timestamps from the first failure after the upgrade, that will be especially helpful.
promised_actions: Escalate to engineering for urgent human investigation.
Request the specific minimum details above to accelerate diagnosis.
Have engineering review the v2.8 upgrade timeline and the token refresh/auth errors in the affected environment and advise on next steps to restore sync/reporting.
safety_notes: Avoid claiming a specific cause or fix without log confirmation.
Do not promise a refund, specific SLA, or definitive resolution; acknowledge escalation and request details.
